The economy sustained momentum through 2025-26, navigating external volatility with resilience, reflected in real GDP growth of 7.3% and and is expected to grow 6.8% in the current financial year (S&P Global; February 2026 estimate).

EBITDA for FY 2025-26 was at ₹ 55,976 crore, registering a Y-o-Y growth of 29% This was primarily driven by stronger commodity prices, rupee depreciation, favourable input cost, higher sales volumes and improved premium mix.
Margins & costs: EBITDA grew 29% to ₹ 55,976 crore, with EBITDA margins expanding sharply by 467 basis points to 39%.

Driven by these transformational efforts, backed by cost optimisation measures and enhanced operational efficiency, Vedanta delivered its best-ever financial performance during FY 2025-26, with a revenue of ₹ 1,74,075 crore and EBITDA of ₹ 55,976 crore.

Capex & expansion: We successfully commissioned major expansion projects across aluminium, zinc, oil & gas, and power, with a capex spend of over ₹ 15,000 crore.
Zinc India's Board has separately approved Phase I capex of ~₹ 17,000 crore to expand refined metal capacity from 1.14 to 2 million metric tonnes.
The Phase II expansion will double mining capacity from 4 MTPA to 8 MTPA and add a new 200 KTPA concentrator plant, taking Gamsberg's total MIC capacity to 450 KTPA.
Balance sheet & cash: We deleveraged VRL 's debt by US$ 4.5 billion over four years to US$ 5.1 billion, while achieving a best-in-class Net Debt/EBITDA of 0.95x at Vedanta India.
We delivered our best ever EBITDA and PAT alongside unrelenting focus on deleveraging, evident through a sub-1x (0.95x) Net Debt/ EBITDA (vs 1.22x in FY 2024-25).

Our commitment to prudent capital allocation and deleveraging further strengthened the balance sheet, with Net Debt to EBITDA improving from 1.22x to a best-in-class 0.95x, reinforcing our financial resilience.
Risks & challenges: During the year, the framework underwent a comprehensive refresh, including the articulation of risk appetite statements, recalibration of scoring methodologies, reassessment of risk scales, and identification of key risk indicators, strengthening the structure and objectivity of risk insights.
